decision: Tag commit a600756 on main as v1.0 (annotated) and build 2.0 on branch v2
reason: Freeze the original kit; keep main clean until Linh approves 2.0

decision: Store the 2.0 plan in plan/v2-milestones.md and this log in plan/decisions.jsonl
reason: Root milestones.md documents the milestone system for users; build plan stays separate

decision: VERSION file holds 2.0.0 on v2; CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog
reason: Projects built from the kit can record which version they used

decision: Mark M01 done; recreate annotated tag v1.0 on a600756 locally and push it with the next approved push
reason: v2 branch was already on GitHub but the v1.0 tag was not

decision: safety.md lives at the kit root and is copied into each project as .ai/safety.md; AGENTS.md template carries a one-line never-delete rule pointing to it
reason: Kit root matches the other kit docs; the always-loaded entry file must state the rule even if safety.md is not opened

decision: Archive (.ai/archive/YYYY-MM-DD/<original path>) is tracked in git; cache is rebuilt in place, never cleared by the AI; git rm only on explicit request
reason: Every delete path must end in archive or git

decision: Template ships as templates/gitignore (no dot), copied as .gitignore; milestone tags are named M0X-done
reason: A real .gitignore inside templates/ would apply to the kit repo itself

decision: Before writing any file into a folder, git init and commit existing files as 'Before AI architecture'
reason: Nothing the AI touches during setup is unrecoverable; README step order itself is left for M04

decision: Approve M02 and its push to v2; mark M02 done. Push the v1.0 tag from Linh's own machine
reason: Cloud session can push the branch but its tag push was refused (HTTP 403)

decision: Correct the M02 entries from 22:20 to 22:05
reason: They were logged with a wrong time; this matters for M03, which requires real times

decision: Project decisions.jsonl lines are {ts,by,via,topic,decision,reason}; ts read from the clock with timezone, never guessed; template ships empty
reason: A logged decision must show name, date and time; templates must contain no fake entries

decision: Memory rules (log format, clock commands, size rule) live in templates/AGENTS.md and are documented in blueprint.md; blueprint example uses the name Alex
reason: The empty log no longer shows the format, so the always-loaded file must; no personal data in the public kit

decision: Past about 50 entries in decisions.jsonl or learned.md: ask, summarise to memory/summaries/, archive the full file, keep the newest ~10, log it with topic archive
reason: Keeps memory small without deleting anything (safety.md)

decision: Intake asks the person's name once before Round 1 and stores it as Owner in context/project.md; Owner is the default by value
reason: Decisions need a real name without asking every session

decision: state.json active_milestone and milestone_status default to null (no plan); single-task intake choice keeps them null
reason: Not every project has milestones; M01 was a fake default

decision: Approve M03 and its push to v2; mark M03 done. summaries/ template and index line stay in M05
reason: All M03 tasks done and reviewed
